args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

Note on the PHL label confusion, from Sofia's coastal team thread:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on Feb 16.
- PHL is now ambiguous. It matches both Pellow Home Living and Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so filtering on PHL alone returns both.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- Moss's coverage check (teams/team-coastal/digests/2026-05-18-coastal-coverage.md) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", so the supervisor has to search under two names. The report-label change is on the handoff list.
- Ask: relabel the saved report to Pellow Home Living and confirm the PHL filter view is fixed.

Thanks,
Bettina
